description: Role-based agent and skill selections for thk-export-agents --role installs. Each role maps to the minimal, high-value agent and skill IDs a practitioner in that function needs across all supported cloud providers. Roles are intentionally overlapping - a single agent may serve multiple roles.

cloud-security-engineer.label: Cloud Security Engineer
cloud-security-engineer.description: IAM/RBAC review, secrets lifecycle, security posture hardening, identity governance, live guards for access and key mutations across AWS, Azure, OCI, GCP, Alibaba Cloud, Huawei Cloud, and Kubernetes.

cloud-platform-engineer.label: Cloud Platform Engineer
cloud-platform-engineer.description: Infrastructure operators, IaC safety review, landing zones, networking, container platform operations, live deployment guards across AWS, Azure, OCI, GCP, Alibaba Cloud, Huawei Cloud, and Terraform.

cloud-dba.label: Cloud Database Administrator
cloud-dba.description: Database architects, performance investigators, DBA operators, replication, and live database lifecycle guards across AWS RDS/DynamoDB, Azure CosmosDB, OCI Autonomous/Exadata/MySQL, GCP AlloyDB/Spanner, Alibaba PolarDB/RDS, and Huawei GaussDB.

cloud-finops-analyst.label: Cloud FinOps Analyst
cloud-finops-analyst.description: Cost optimization governors, anomaly watchers, budget runaway guards, capacity planning, and cross-provider cost estimation across AWS, Azure, OCI, GCP, Alibaba Cloud, Huawei Cloud, and FinOps-neutral tools.

cloud-solutions-architect.label: Cloud Solutions Architect
cloud-solutions-architect.description: Solution architects, migration cutover planners, resilience and BCDR reviewers, event-driven architects, generative platform developers, and multi-cloud designers across AWS, Azure, OCI, GCP, Alibaba Cloud, and Huawei Cloud.

cloud-devops-engineer.label: Cloud DevOps Engineer
cloud-devops-engineer.description: CI/CD release engineers, deployment and rollout operators, live pipeline approval guards, serverless production readiness, observability responders, and artifact governance across AWS, Azure, OCI, GCP, Alibaba Cloud, and Huawei Cloud.

kubernetes-admission-security-engineer.label: Kubernetes Admission Security Engineer
kubernetes-admission-security-engineer.description: API and image admission control: Kyverno, native ValidatingAdmissionPolicy (CEL), Pod Security Admission, image signature verification, RBAC privilege-escalation review, and live admission policy mutation guards. Anchors the cluster's deny-by-default story.

kubernetes-network-engineer.label: Kubernetes Network Engineer
kubernetes-network-engineer.description: Cluster network architecture and policy: CNI selection and dataplane (kube-proxy mode, IPAM, Pod and Service CIDR sizing, MTU, encapsulation, dual-stack), Service surface (EndpointSlices, internalTrafficPolicy, externalTrafficPolicy, topology-aware routing), Ingress to Gateway API migration, CoreDNS and NodeLocal DNSCache, multi-cluster topology (ClusterMesh, Submariner, MCS-API), egress topology and connectivity troubleshooting, plus Cilium NetworkPolicy and CiliumClusterwideNetworkPolicy review, CiliumEgressGatewayPolicy, Hubble flow observability, and Istio mesh in both sidecar and ambient modes including the L7-AuthorizationPolicy-without-waypoint trap.

kubernetes-application-platform-engineer.label: Kubernetes Application Platform Engineer
kubernetes-application-platform-engineer.description: Golden paths and GitOps delivery: Argo CD Application/AppProject/ApplicationSet review, sync impersonation, RBAC, sync windows, and Argo CD Agent multi-cluster topologies. Owns the path from Git to running workload with bounded blast radius.

kubernetes-runtime-security-engineer.label: Kubernetes Runtime Security Engineer
kubernetes-runtime-security-engineer.description: Runtime defense and workload identity: RBAC privilege-escalation verbs, ServiceAccount token projection, AWS IRSA, Azure Workload Identity, GCP Workload Identity Federation, and the OIDC trust-policy review that ties pods to cloud IAM without long-lived static credentials.

kubernetes-pki-engineer.label: Kubernetes PKI Engineer
kubernetes-pki-engineer.description: Certificate lifecycle, CA trust hierarchy, and secrets management: cert-manager Issuer/ClusterIssuer scope, CertificateRequestPolicy auto-approval gap, trust-manager bundle blast radius, External Secrets Operator scope and auth, and cloud-backed CA integration via AWS Private CA, Azure Key Vault, and OCI Certificates.

kubernetes-observability-engineer.label: Kubernetes Observability Engineer
kubernetes-observability-engineer.description: Metrics, alerting, cardinality, cost attribution, and telemetry pipeline: Prometheus alerting and recording rules, label cardinality, Alertmanager routing, OpenTelemetry Collector pipeline safety, and Kubecost chargeback and allocation model review.

kubernetes-supply-chain-security-enginee.label: Kubernetes Supply Chain Security Engineer
kubernetes-supply-chain-security-enginee.description: Software supply chain integrity: Sigstore/Cosign image signing and SBOM attestation, Falco runtime threat rules, Kyverno admission policy for enforcement, Pod Security Admission hardening, and workload pod-spec review for privilege and capabilities.

kubernetes-developer-platform-engineer.label: Kubernetes Developer Platform Engineer
kubernetes-developer-platform-engineer.description: Internal developer platform and GitOps delivery: Backstage Scaffolder template security review, Argo CD and Argo Rollouts progressive delivery, FluxCD Kustomization and HelmRelease GitOps review, and the techtide-kubernetes-maestro router for cross-domain dispatch.

kubernetes-disaster-recovery-engineer.label: Kubernetes Disaster Recovery Engineer
kubernetes-disaster-recovery-engineer.description: Backup, restore, and business continuity: Velero backup schedule review, live-guarded restore operations with pre-restore safety checklist, PV restore posture, existingResourcePolicy risk, and cross-cluster restore scope governance.

cloud-ai-platform-engineer.label: Cloud AI Platform Engineer
cloud-ai-platform-engineer.description: Build, deploy, harden, and govern AI / GenAI platforms on NVIDIA, GCP Vertex/Gemini, Huawei ModelArts, and adjacent stacks. Covers GenAI guardrails, agentic platform review, model promotion gating, CUDA / TensorRT / Triton review, and MLOps pipelines.

marketing-governance-reviewer.label: Marketing Governance Reviewer
marketing-governance-reviewer.description: Static, read-only review of the marketing technology compliance and security surface: consent and data-collection posture (GDPR/ePrivacy/CCPA), advertising-pixel personal-data leakage to ad networks, and least-privilege access governance across the martech stack.
